release_notes:
🎉 First Public Beta!

Welcome to Covary — a research tool for tracking behavioral patterns.

- Guided onboarding with research presets
- Morning/Afternoon/Evening check-in windows with smart notifications
- Quick-track buttons and Today's Timeline
- Metric Insights with dual-metric comparison
- Correlation Matrix and Lagged Trend analysis
- Health Connect integration (steps, sleep)
- App Usage tracking (Android)
- Full JSON data export/import
- Automatic update notifications
- Customizable themes and dark mode
- Data Quality dashboard
